pioneers.midnightconfig.title: Pioneers Additions
pioneers.midnightconfig.DEFAULT_COLOUR.t: Players will start as this colour when they join the world.
pioneers.midnightconfig.GREEN_LIVES.tool: When a player loses all their Green lives they turn Yellow.
pioneers.midnightconfig.YELLOW_LIVES.too: When a player loses all their Yellow lives they turn Red.
pioneers.midnightconfig.RED_LIVES.toolti: When a player loses all their Red lives they become a Ghost.
pioneers.midnightconfig.LIVES_LOST_ON_DE: Number of lives the player will lose when they die.
pioneers.midnightconfig.LIVES_GAINED_ON_:
Yellow players gain lives from killing Green players.

Red players gain lives from killing Green or Yellow players.

Green and Ghost players cannot gain lives.
pioneers.midnightconfig.ENABLE_GIVE_COMM:
Enables the "/lives give" command which allows players to give lives to each other.

Ghost players cannot give or receive lives using this command.
pioneers.midnightconfig.ENABLE_LIFE_TOKE:
Enables the Life Token item which can be crafted and consumed by players to gain a single life.

Ghost players cannot gain lives using this item.

pioneers.midnightconfig.TERM_FOR_LIVES_P: Term used to refer to multiple lives (case insensitive).

pioneers.midnightconfig.YELLOW_GROUP_NAM: Name used to refer to Yellow players (case sensitive).
